answer: Each wallet must spend memory before attesting. Its address and the epoch seed derive a scrypt puzzle: four gigabytes for thirty seconds, digest pasted into the answer. Alter either input and the work restarts, so one solution cannot cover a thousand clones and old digests die at the horizon. A thousand identities need four terabytes of RAM, near $120 daily at spot rates, while a fake attestation pays under a dollar: the nadir arrives when farming costs more than it mints. Marble is cheap per block because the quarry is open; hire a thousand masons and the bill beats the first column.
